reason: G-III is a brand owner that designs apparel and accessories and sells them mainly wholesale to retailers. It also sells to consumers through its own stores and sites. QVC Group is a video-commerce retailer that sells a broad range of merchandise directly to consumers. The two overlap on consumer-facing fashion and on direct-to-consumer selling. They differ on core model: G-III is a wholesaler and brand owner, while QVC is a multi-category retailer. QVC is closer to being a customer channel for G-III than a direct competitor.
